verdict.rationale: xAI's first-party docs describe Remote MCP Tools, which let Grok connect to external MCP servers and use their custom tools from third parties or your own implementations. That is exactly the client-side plug-in capability this story asks for, and the probe confirms the dedicated remote-mcp docs page exists. Missing for 10: detail in the pack on configuration, auth and tool allow-listing, any evidence for local/stdio MCP servers beyond remote ones, and independent or hands-on corroboration that it works.
